description: A busy modern capital that mixes technology, food and tradition.
familyTips: Ueno Zoo, teamLab and Tokyo Disneyland suit kids. Trains are stroller-friendly.
bestSeason: March to May, October to November

description: A clean, safe city-state with many family attractions.
familyTips: Singapore Zoo, Gardens by the Bay and Sentosa are all easy with children.

description: A lively capital known for street food, temples and big shopping malls.
familyTips: Safari World, SEA LIFE aquarium and air-conditioned malls are good for kids, especially in the heat.

description: A tropical island with beaches, rice terraces and friendly local culture.
familyTips: Choose calm beaches such as Sanur for young children. Bali Safari and Water Park is a family favourite.

description: A Malaysian island with beaches, mangroves, waterfalls and cable car views.
familyTips: Try the Kilim mangrove tour, the Sky Cab and Underwater World. Easy to reach from Malaysia.
